claims.statement: Provider-source observations preserve provider/resource identity, source reference, normalized payload content, bounded observation window, normalization replayability disclosure, assurance class, collector metadata, retention semantics, and canonical digests without claiming cryptographic provider attestation.

The HAK-012 projection validator requires every leaf of the frozen HAK-011 provider snapshot to be mapped exactly once from a digest-bound source observation and reconstruct to the exact target value.
Workflow-run, workflow-jobs, and workflow-job-steps evidence scopes are not interchangeable even when a substituted source happens to contain the same value.
Locally digest-bound provider observations and projection maps cannot self-upgrade ProviderObserved evidence into CryptographicallyAttested evidence.
Canonical payload, observation, projection, and frozen-target digests detect the tested forms of post-materialization tampering and source repointing.
